# dsh-boot-splash · a boot film for DeepSeek Harness

The white‑and‑blue whale sits alone in the middle of the window. As the app loads it is
**flooded bl

ack from below** — ink rising like a tide — and the moment loading finishes it is
completely black.

Then it glides left, pulling `| deepseek HARNESS` out of its own body, settles
with a small bounce,
and hands the window back to the app.
中文说明见 README.zh.md。
## Timeline (7.6 s, one deterministic clock)
| Time | Beat |
| 0.0 s | the blue whale condenses out of a soft blue bloom, breathing on a blurred contact shadow |
| 1.1 s | ink floods up the body; **the tide line is the progress bar**, with a white meniscus on i

ts edge |
| 3.5 s | the whale is fully black; the bloom exhales once, shed particles fade out |
| 3.

6 s | a specular sweep crosses the black body |
| 3.7 s | glide left: 3° bank, a hairline wake and t

wo afterimages, condensing to wordmark size |
| 4.3 s | `deepseek` is drawn out of the whale glyph b

y glyph, resolving from blur |
| 5.1 s | the black plate slides out of the end of the wordmark, unco

vering `HARNESS` |
| 5.6 s | lands with a 1.3 % rebound and a slow breath; a faint signature rule bl

ooms and dissolves |
| 6.5 s | a slow light sweep across the finished lockup |
| 6.9 s | the whole l
ayer fades out (1.2 % slow zoom) and reveals the app |

Click anywhere to skip. Colours are restricted to black, white, grey and blue: the only
non‑grayscal
e tokens are `#2f6bff`, `#8db8ff` and the bloom.

**This version has no loading ring.** Progress is carried by the ink tide, its white meniscus,
the c

harging bloom and the particles shed along the flood line. A few typographic layers were
added at th

e same time — film grain, corner falloff, a contact shadow under the mark, a wake
hairline during th
e glide, and a signature rule under the finished lockup.
## The artwork is the real thing

There is no typesetting: the whale mark, `deepseek` wordmark, plate and `HARNESS` glyphs are the
app

's own vectors, extracted from `favicon.svg` + `welcome-brand.svg` inside `app.asar` by
`dev/build-l

ogo-data.mjs` into `dev/logo-data.js`.
The last frame is pixel‑identical to the sidebar brand row.
## Install

Restart the app (or the `dsh web` process) once; the film plays on the next page load and
unmounts i
tself when the clock ends. It plays once per page load.
## Layout
Three readable sources, assembled by `build.mjs`:

* `src/scene.css` — bloom, vignette, grain, contact shadow, wake, signature rule, lockup layout.
* `

src/scene.html` — the hero whale's SVG, particle layer, finished lockup.
* `src/timeline.js` — the o

nly clock: `mountSplash(host, logo, opts)` with a pure `render(t)`
that draws any instant of the fil

m, so it can be frozen or scrubbed.
* `client.js` — generated; a React component registered on the `

shell.overlay` slot, cleaned up
through `ctx.effect`.
* `src/splash.js` — generated, used only by `d

ev/boot.html` so the preview runs shipped code.
* `lib/index.js` — intentionally empty host half, so

the loader mounts a fiber and the client
bundle reaches the page.
* `dev/` — `boot.html` (`?t=1200`

freezes a frame), `shot.mjs` (deterministic CDP capture),
`frames.py` (contact sheets), `integratio

n.html` (runs the shipped `client.js` against a tiny
`__ModuleLoader__`/React stub), `make-gif.mjs`

ns the shipped `client.js` against a tiny
`__ModuleLoader__`/React stub), `make-gif.mjs` + `gif.py`.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Notes

* Painted on `shell.overlay`: no app root replacement, no sidebar DOM, no reading other plugins'
DOM

, never clipped by scroll containers.
* Decoration only: no host behaviour, no settings namespace, n

o network.
* Brand vectors belong to DeepSeek and ship only as part of this fan‑made boot film; the

plugin
code itself is MIT.
